title: Equity Bias: An Ethical Framework for AI Design
abstract: arXiv:2604.21907v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Equity Bias is a philosophical and practical framework for building more equitable AI systems. It treats AI as an interpretive agent that constructs meaning and knowledge rather than as a neutral calculator. Grounded in Gadamerian hermeneutics and epistemic injustice theory, Equity Bias views bias not as an error to eliminate but as a reflection of whose knowledge is encoded into systems. Since all knowledge is situated, neutral systems are not possible. While traditional approaches aim to reduce or remove bias, Equity Bias instead makes bias transparent and contestable. Its three-stage AI Life Cycle (Equity Archaeology, Co-Creating Meaning, and Ongoing Accountability) turns these principles into practice. Equity Bias gives developers, researchers, policymakers, and communities affected by AI a method for examining whose knowledge a system encodes and who has the power to contest it. translated_title: 公平性偏见：一种人工智能设计的伦理框架
translated_abstract: 公平性偏见是一个用于构建更公平人工智能系统的哲学与实践框架。它将人工智能视为构建意义与知识的解释性主体，而非中立的计算器。该框架植根于伽达默尔诠释学和认知不公正理论，不将偏见视为需要消除的错误，而是将其视为谁的知识被编码进系统的一种反映。由于所有知识都是有处境性的，中立系统是不可能存在的。与传统旨在减少或消除偏见的方法不同，公平性偏见反而使偏见变得透明且可质疑。其三阶段人工智能生命周期（公平考古、共同创造意义、持续问责）将这些原则付诸实践。公平性偏见为开发者、研究人员、政策制定者以及受人工智能影响的社区提供了一种方法，用以审视一个系统编码了谁的知识，以及谁有权对此提出质疑。通过将知识的政治性置于……
tldr: 提出了“公平性偏见”框架，主张偏见不应被消除而应被透明化和可质疑化，并通过三阶段AI生命周期将伽达默尔诠释学与认知不公正理论转化为构建更公平AI系统的实践方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes the "Equity Bias" framework, arguing that bias should be made transparent and contestable rather than eliminated, and operationalizes Gadamerian hermeneutics and epistemic injustice theory through a three-stage AI Life Cycle to build more equitable AI systems.
